Background
• Life is a continuous journey of change, and as the saying goes, the only constant
in life is change itself.
• However, human nature is about control, dominion, it's about being able to
predict what is to come and this hunger has driven humanity to great
innovation.
• Loss of control, uncertainty and “Fear of the unknown” can leave one stuck and
unable to drive progress and derive pleasure and fulfilment of their potential.
Justification
• Owing to these facts, it is important for people to build their capacity to weather
the continuous changes in life.
• Internal potential (God given) to become the best version of themselves and
make the best of everything that life offers.
• Identifying, understanding and applying a set of skills is critical in achieving
these aspirations
• Schools have not done enough with many graduates lacking coping mechanisms
